mentions.name: Type-safe full-stack web framework/template
mentions.description: A full-stack framework/template for building performant, quality web apps quickly. It aims to be 100% statically type-safe across the stack, use a SQL-first approach for the database layer(s), and require only a minimal amount of boilerplate — just enough for a clean architecture without magic.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on assembling a full-stack framework/template that aims at building performant and quality web apps very quickly.

It's going to be 100% statically type-safe across the stack, SQL first for the DB layer(s), and with a minimal amount of boilerplate (just enough for a clean architecture without magic).
